stations.title: Dilys
stations.say: Why did the hours stay grey?
stations.note: She tried a few rules herself.

stations.title: styles.css
stations.text: Her rules are there, but older ones win.

captions: Dilys changed the stylesheet herself, and wants to know why three changes did not show.
Her rules are in the file, but other rules beat them, so the hours stay grey.
You work out why each rule wins or loses, set the font once and name the colours.
The opening hours turn clay, and the rest of Visit us stays grey.
Same look Dilys wanted. Now every rule wins for a reason you can see.
